# Di Blythe

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Di Blythe strongly resembles her mother, possessing red, ruddy hair that she is not entirely resigned to. Her gray-green eyes are notable for glowing with a unique lustre and brilliancy in the dusk.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P52](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0052)_

## Personality

Di harbors a strong desire to travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) alongside [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md). Additionally, she experiences a sense of fear regarding [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P53](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0053), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001)_

## History

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) [Blythe](../character/blythe.md), known as Di, resembled her mother with her red hair and shining gray-green eyes, and she was her father's favorite child. She and her siblings bonded with the Meredith children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), quickly becoming fast friends after sharing a meal of cooked trout. Over time, she frequently gathered with the other local children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to hear stories, share meals, and discuss community gossip.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P17](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), +14 more_

## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di-blythe--faith.md)

Di and [Faith](../character/faith.md) are sworn friends and allies who bonded when the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) and Meredith children met in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and shared cooked trout while exchanging life stories. Di regularly joins [Faith](../character/faith.md) and the rest of their combined group of friends to play, hear news, and discuss various topics in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +11 more_

### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/di-blythe--una-meredith.md)

Di and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) became sworn friends and allies after their respective families met in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children shared their trout and exchanged stories with the [Merediths](../codex/factions.md#merediths). Di continues to socialize with [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and their shared circle of friends during frequent gatherings in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), +9 more_
